import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000007L;
    static int K;
    static long N;
    static List<Integer> num = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<long[][]>> base = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<long[][]>> pref = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<long[][]>> suf = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[][] trans;
    static long ans;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();

        while (N != 0) {
            num.add((int) (N % K));
            N /= K;
        }

        // Initialize base matrices
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
            List<long[][]> baseRow = new ArrayList<>();
            List<long[][]> prefRow = new ArrayList<>();
            List<long[][]> sufRow = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
                baseRow.add(new long[K + 1][K + 1]);
                prefRow.add(new long[K + 1][K + 1]);
                sufRow.add(new long[K + 1][K + 1]);
            }
            base.add(baseRow);
            pref.add(prefRow);
            suf.add(sufRow);
        }

        // Build initial base matrices
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            long[][] matrix = new long[K + 1][K + 1];
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l <= K; l++) {
                    matrix[j][l] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                matrix[j][j] = 1;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                matrix[j][i] = 1;
            }
            base.get(0).set(i, matrix);
        }

        // Build prefix and suffix matrices
        for (int i = 1; i < num.size(); i++) {
            int idx = i - 1;
            // Initialize pref and suf for this index
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                pref.get(idx).set(j, base.get(i - 1).get(0));
                suf.get(idx).set(j, base.get(i - 1).get(K - 1));
            }

            // Compute prefix
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                pref.get(idx).set(j, matMultiply(pref.get(idx).get(j - 1), base.get(i - 1).get(j)));
            }

            // Compute suffix
            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                suf.get(idx).set(j, matMultiply(base.get(i - 1).get(j), suf.get(idx).get(j + 1)));
            }

            // Update base matrices for next iteration
            base.get(i).set(0, pref.get(idx).get(K - 1));
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                base.get(i).set(j, matMultiply(suf.get(idx).get(j), pref.get(idx).get(j - 1)));
            }
        }

        // Initialize trans matrix
        trans = new long[K + 1][K + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                trans[i][j] = 0;
            }
            trans[i][i] = 1;
        }

        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = num.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int x = num.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < x; j++) {
                trans = matMultiply(trans, base.get(i).get(sum));
                sum++;
                if (sum >= K) sum -= K;
            }
        }

        ans = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            ans += trans[K][i];
            ans %= INF;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long[][] matMultiply(long[][] a, long[][] b) {
        int size = K + 1;
        long[][] res = new long[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                res[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                    res[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j];
                }
                res[i][j] %= INF;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
}
